Howdy. I'm a research technician at IMP, Vienna with [Sven Klumpe](https://www.imp.ac.at/groups/sven-klumpe), formerly at UBC, Vancouver with [Khanh Dao Duc](https://kdaoduc.com/about/).

I have done work in structural biology infrastructure (atomic models, CryoET), ML applications to cryoEM, shape analysis, built and maintain [ribosome.xyz](https://ribosome.xyz/) and [tubulin.xyz](https://tubulin.xyz/).

I planted ~250,000 trees in the north-west of Canada between 2016 and 2018. My favourite book is probably All the Pretty Horses and if I could live anywhere it'd be Vancouver Island. I live in Vienna now.

[rtkushner@gmail.com](mailto:rtkushner@gmail.com).
